params.caption: 🕹️ Xbox: Project Helix is a console first, with PC games on top Xbox VP of Next Generation Jason Ronald says Helix is built as a console that can also run your PC games, not a PC that runs console games. He promises four generations of Xbox library and progress carried over, and a push on neural rendering to make better frames without extra hardware power or memory.
